newsitem.title: CHINA: China PICC farm premiums up 15.8 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China PICC farm premiums up 15.8 percent in 1996.

text.p: Farm insurance premiums of the People's Insurance Company of China Property rose by 15.8 percent in 1996 from the previous year, the Financial News said on Tuesday.
The newspaper did not give actual figures.
PICC Property, a subsidiary of the state-owned PICC Group, has seen premium income from its agricultural insurance policies decline in recent years, it said.
The company attributed the surge to improved management of farm insurance in 1996, it said, but gave no further details.
The firm would boost insurance business in farms in city outskirts and offer more cover to value-added projects in 1997, it said.
